resilienceScope.policy: Adopted integrity requirements never defer due to budget exhaustion; checkpoint and report unmet.
deferredOptional: Foreign runtime callbacks and framework adapters belong to following phases, not this acceptance boundary.

requiredSafetyChecks.description: No lost attempts, source identities, evidence or silent fallback.
Rust extensions cannot override core names or another registration.

budgets.tokenFallback: Use elapsed time and tool-call ceiling; checkpoint before exhaustion.

consumedAtAuthoring.scope: Owner-adopted implementation starts after binding; preceding planning retained separately.

budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint and BLOCKED; preserve all evidence and do not claim success.

evidenceInvalidation: Bind source, contract, oracle, runtime and package digests. Invalidate only affected behavior after material changes; retain old evidence and consumed repair budget.

workerRoutes.billing: Existing user-authorized internal execution; no external inference providers
workerRoutes.subagents: Separate Rust SDK, Node and Python adapter scopes; root acceptance orchestration. Review dormant until complete BDD success.

expectedEffects: Generate locks/build native artifacts/package local archives at completed boundary
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: Owner explicitly adopted this phase and directed implementation, phase-end BDD, internal review/material corrections and origin preservation. No registration/publication/deployment authorized.
cleanup: Remove only recorded temporary consumer environments after both packets; retain archives and original evidence.
stopConditions: Fail on missing tools or native artifacts
Stop after unexpected side effects or exhausted repair budget
